routeEvidence.detail: Lazy import of the assigned page.
signal-log route mounts SignalLogViewer within SafeRoute.

purpose: Explicitly query bounded per-signal historical samples and compare HTTP/MQTT producer-time evidence for the submitted vehicle and window.
primaryGoal: Select signals, submit a query, inspect returned counts, chart, value composition, transport evidence and paginated expandable rows without changing telemetry.

dataSources.owner: Telemetry catalog API hook; backend apisignal handler
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-enabled, cancellable catalog read; rich catalog is reduced to names; STANDARD stale time. Metadata is not available to this selector.
dataSources.backendBehavior: Route registration verified only; deployed availability and response semantics unverified.

dataSources.owner: Typed signals API hook; backend apisignal history handler
dataSources.behavior: Only enabled after submission; revision, vehicle, signals, bounds and limit in query key. URI-encoded signal name, AbortSignal forwarding, historical policy, Promise.all fan-out. Each request asks for perPage * 10 rows. Returned data arrays are null-safe normalized before the page adapts and sorts them.
dataSources.backendBehavior: Actual limit enforcement, ordering, full-window completeness and exclusive-upper-bound semantics not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.owner: Typed signals API hook and TransportAgreementPanel; backend apisignal handler
dataSources.behavior: Independent historical query, abort forwarding. Panel withholds requests beyond its source-defined 168-hour cap without narrowing history bounds. Displays retained/fatal/no-evidence/insufficient-overlap/truncated/invalid-row states.
dataSources.backendBehavior: 168-hour frontend guard confirmed; backend cap implementation was not read. Agreement mathematics and runtime units unverified.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace, URL and product-preference hooks
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned vehicle and date scope, URL-backed signals; explicitly submitted snapshot remains independent of subsequent draft control edits.
dataSources.inspectionLimit: Only useRangeState implementation inspected; other imported preference/URL/vehicle hooks not traced internally.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local valueType duplicates the inspected getValueType helper but drops its null branch.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consolidate type classification in the existing signal-domain helper, with a localized display label at the caller.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local duration formatting bypasses the existing raw-seconds metric formatting path for the observed sample span.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the accepted duration display policy, or retain this specialist representation through a locale-aware shared formatter after parity verification.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Query controls stack below sm; signal names wrap; chart/composition stack until xl then use 2:1 columns. Table container is min-w-0/max-w-full with 520px maximum height; agreement list reflows at lg.

issues.detail: DataTable receives no mobilePresentation. The type column is not marked visibleOnMobile, so the existing mobile column filter can hide it; no source-confirmed mobile replacement exposes type independently of expansion.
issues.fix: Use the existing opt-in mobile table contract where appropriate, retaining timestamp, value, type, signal, expansion/copy, table ID, ordering and pagination. Verify type remains reachable at narrow allocated widths; do not delete fields to fit.

sourcePositives: Action icons are aria-hidden; Query and Per page have localized visible labels.
ComboboxMulti exposes associated label, listbox and multiselect ARIA; actual keyboard flow not exercised.
SignalHistoryTable names its region with useId; JSON copy uses a shared action.
Overlay chart passes accessible data rows/columns to EmbeddedChart; table/list semantics are present.

issues.detail: Historical lines explicitly set isAnimationActive to true through !isLive without a motion preference check in this component.
issues.fix: Verify shared chart-level reduced-motion enforcement; if absent, consume the canonical motion preference for this animation without changing timing APIs or chart behavior.

accessibility.runtime: Keyboard, focus, screen reader, touch-target sizes, contrast, forced colors, text zoom and motion are unverified.

states.beforeSubmission: No vehicle produces a shared empty prerequisite; with a vehicle, all results panels remain present. Summary marks unknown; breakdown and agreement explain submission prerequisite.
states.initialLoading: Batch history provides chart/table/breakdown skeletons and summary loading. Catalog query state is not forwarded to selector.
states.empty: Chart, table and composition provide empty bodies. Zero returned-row counts are actual empty batch counts, not server-wide totals.
states.fatal: Top AlertBanner plus per-panel SourceContent fatal recovery; agreement independently retries. Catalog fatal error has no dedicated retry action.
states.retained: useDataState preserves batch payload and top-level StaleRefreshWarning; summary marks retained. Agreement keeps usable data after refresh failures.
states.offline: Canonical DataState distinguishes paused/blocked state; no offline runtime exercised.

issues.detail: SignalSelector receives catalog data ?? [] but neither loading nor error/retry state. Initial loading and successful empty catalog are indistinguishable in the picker; fatal catalog failure is only the general alert.
issues.fix: Forward catalog loading and localized source-specific failure/empty/retry presentation using ComboboxMulti.loading and existing SourceContent/feedback. Keep retained names selectable on refresh failure.

issues.detail: Batch uses Promise.all: any single signal history failure rejects the aggregate, so initial successful neighbors are not exposed. Page derives one aggregate fatal state, not per-signal partial coverage.
issues.fix: Have the integration owner assess a typed per-signal retained/fatal/empty/retry contract using existing evidence-source conventions. Preserve keys, immutable submission, raw SI, request cancellation and query policy; never label failed signals as empty or remove their identities.

visualIssues.detail: BAR_COLORS hardcodes a cyan/green/amber hex palette, outside the shared theme/semantic palette.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse restrained existing semantic chart tokens; retain numeric/text/boolean labels, proportions, counts and user chart color preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Signal body text takes CHART_COLORS in addition to a color dot; chart identity is applied to potentially long body strings rather than neutral readable text.
visualIssues.fix: Keep chart/table identity in the dot and shared palette, use theme-aware primary body text, and measure composed contrast across themes. Do not reset persisted chart colors.

visualIssues.detail: Observed-span formatter hardcodes s/m/h/d and interpolates unlocalized numbers; it overrides the duration metric formatter.
visualIssues.fix: Preserve observed-span meaning and rounding while reusing locale-aware seconds-to-duration display formatting.

visualIssues.detail: Type badge prints internal English strings number/string/boolean directly.
visualIssues.fix: Keep machine type identifiers stable and use localized visible type labels, including a distinct unknown/null label.

architectureIssues.detail: Consumes calendar start/end, then reconstructs browser-local midnight to 23:59:59.999 instead of hook startInstant/endInstantExclusive. Rolling Live/24h exact bounds and exclusive-upper-bound semantics are lost.
architectureIssues.fix: Capture canonical hook instants on Query, retaining immutable submission and the same unshortened agreement window. Integration owner must verify endpoint upper-bound semantics rather than assuming them.

architectureIssues.detail: Submitted vehicle remains frozen after header vehicle changes. Result scope caption exposes only timestamps, so old-vehicle results can remain beside a new active workspace vehicle with no result-vehicle identity.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve deliberate query-on-click semantics, but explicitly label the submitted vehicle and identify draft-versus-submitted scope changes. Do not silently attribute old results to the new selection or erase retained data.

architectureIssues.detail: Only first 20 fields are rendered. Showing N of total is present, but no reveal/pagination action accesses remaining per-signal evidence.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain initial compact presentation while making every returned field reachable through existing pagination/reveal primitives; preserve original order and source values.

architectureIssues.detail: Rows with all nullable value fields absent are classified string even though the value cell is an em dash and summary does not count them as text.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse the existing helper's null classification and show neutral unavailable/unknown type; retain false and numeric zero as measured values.

architectureIssues.detail: Types/adaptation come from component-root SignalQueryControls; that inspected module also contains older control implementations. Only helper functions/types, not its legacy components, are mounted by this page.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should consolidate signal adaptation/types under existing domain utility ownership, then update consumers together. Do not reintroduce legacy controls or an alternative fetch layer.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 / MDC-046 preservation of source evidence
architectureIssues.detail: Adaptation reduces history envelopes to timestamp/name/primitive values. JSON expansion serializes that adapted row, not original kind, ingest origin, producer/receipt time or normalization metadata retained by the hook.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current primitive display and raw SI; integration owner should retain available original envelope metadata for clearly labeled raw inspection/copy, rather than implying the adapter JSON is a complete payload.

priority.first: Canonical workspace instants, submitted-vehicle identity and source trust
priority.next: Reachability of all agreement fields, null classification, catalog feedback
priority.then: Restrained palette, locale-aware duration/types and mobile/keyboard verification

usedBy: Other selector consumers require integration-owner inventory before changing required props

requiredSharedChanges.decision: integration assessment, not page-owned hook rewrite
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Typed identities with retained data, exact submitted bounds, fatalError versus refreshError, unavailable versus pending, updatedAt, cancellation and individual retry. Reuse existing evidence-source conventions; preserve current batch keys until a coordinated migration.
dependsOn: Existing signal evidence bundle contract MDC-002
requiredSharedChanges.evidenceLimit: Other production consumers and evidence bundle internals not inspected; no speculative second query system authorized.

requiredSharedChanges.decision: reuse existing API; no shared table edit evidenced
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: mobilePresentation opt-in, embedded variant, loaded rows, stable tableId, columns, row key, expansion and caller pagination. Preserve all details/copy and keep export scope truthful if exports are enabled later.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Signal row adaptation/type utility ownership
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: SignalLogEntry, adaptSignalHistoryPoint, formatValue, null/number/string/boolean classification; optional original envelope retention. Keep null, false and zero distinct; no physical conversion in cache/wire.
dependsOn: Typed history envelope ownership in useSignals

competingImplementations.detail: Module imported for helpers also defines old SignalMultiSelect with independent query/search state. Assigned page actually mounts SignalSelector/ComboboxMulti, not that implementation.
competingImplementations.fix: Do not adopt legacy controls; coordinate utility ownership separately. No source deletion authorized by this audit.

preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus SignalSelector, SignalChartPanel, SignalHistoryTable, SignalLogKpiBand, SignalLogBreakdownPanel, TransportAgreementPanel, TransportAgreementMetrics, TransportAgreementFieldList, signalLogSummary and TelemetrySummaryBrief. Shared domain dependencies are not exclusive page-owned implementation targets.

sections.name: Query summary: records, selected/observed signals, numeric, text, boolean, observed span
HTTP/MQTT transport agreement with per-signal evidence
Paginated signal history and JSON expansion

preservation.dependencySections: Chart, breakdown, history and agreement each retain their own GlassPanel; KPI uses OperationalBrief rather than an artificial extra panel. Six semantic page regions, not inferred from root GlassPanel count.
actions: Explicit Query and repeat Query revision
Chart legend visibility and shared accessible data surface
dataBehavior: Query-on-click; immutable submitted vehicle/signals/window/page size and unique revision.
Limit per signal equals submitted perPage * 10; local newest-first pagination over returned rows only.
Summary and composition describe loaded rows, never server-wide counts or guaranteed whole-window coverage.
Observed time span remains separate from submitted range.
Boolean chart projection uses 1/0; nonfinite/nonnumeric values are null gaps; stats use finite numeric samples.
Retained payload and source warnings survive refresh failure.
Transport agreement keeps exact submitted bounds; over-limit history still renders.
Measured, no_evidence, insufficient_overlap, truncated and invalid-row transport distinctions remain.
Shared table persistence identity telemetry:signal-history and legend/chart identities remain.
No SI wire/cache conversion introduced; generic raw signal values must not be assigned guessed units.
All returned agreement fields must become reachable without removing the existing initial compact view.
preservation.baselineComparison: Current source snapshot only; no Git, historical baseline or implementation delta.
